title: NIST releases Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0
summary: The first major update since 2014 adds a sixth function, Govern, and broadens the framework to organizations of every size and sector — the basis of ByteGuardian's assessment.

title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 transition period has ended
summary: Certificates issued against ISO/IEC 27001:2013 expired at the end of the three-year transition. Certified organizations must now meet the 2022 edition and its updated Annex A controls.

title: Thailand's PDPA: personal data protection is in full force
summary: The Personal Data Protection Act requires organizations to secure personal data and report breaches, with administrative fines of up to 5 million baht per violation, plus criminal and civil liability.
